title: Career - When AI R&D Speeds Up 2x What Do You Learn
content:
METR ne 5 Nov 2026 ko independent
assessment publish kiya.
Window: 12 Aug se 29 Oct 2026. High-access
evaluation at Anthropic — AI kitna AI R&D
accelerate kar raha hai.
Headline: Anthropic likely improving model
capabilities on well-specified tasks at
around TWICE THE RATE versus March 2024 to
October 2025.
Career angle aaj: salary invent nahi
karunga. Skills bataunga jo gate-designers
hire karwate hain.
End tak raho.
Numbers sirf metr.org page se.
Since October 2025, AECI benchmark scores
estimated 1.9 TIMES acceleration. 95% confidence interval 1.5 to 2.8
times.
Roughly 2 years of historical progress
in the last year.
METR subjective: around twice the rate;
would not be surprised if true rate closer
to 1.3x or 3x.
Majority of current October 2026
acceleration likely attributable to AI
used for R&D — METR ka uncertain guess
roughly 80% due to AI.
Acceleration training-compute scaling ki
wajah se NAHI hai — is pe METR confident.
Next 12 months ke liye clear bottlenecks
identify nahi hue — lekin METR uncertain
hai.
Anthropic ne majority of most informative
evidence redact kiya. Full report roughly
100 pages.
Ek aur number carefully.
Slack poll self-reported uplift reaching
about 12x in October 2026.
METR explicitly kehta hai yeh VERY LOOSE
evidence hai — low-effort reactions,
unrepresentative subset.
Isliye career advice mein 12x ko gospel mat banao.
Solid signal yeh hai: AI-assisted R&D —
coding, analyzing experiments —
acceleration ka bada driver hai, fully
autonomous contributions abhi main story
nahi, signs of life hain.
Jab R&D tempo 2x ho, kaunsi skills scarce
rehti hain.
Skill 1: harness design. Agents ko bounds,
eval sets, kill switches.
Skill 2: verification loops. Agent diff
padho. Tests, secrets, invented APIs check
karo.
Skill 3: HUMAN APPROVAL GATES. Refund,
send, publish, merge — irreversible pe
human tap.
Skill 4: REJECT LOGS. Har edit aur reject
pe reason code. Woh tumhara portfolio
banega.
Yeh same pattern Cursor ke
explicit-publish gate aur Perplexity ke
check-with-me-before-refund line mein
dikhta hai — product signal: humans who
design gates get hired.
Ishan Sharma style practical move — bina
salary fantasy ke.
Portfolio: ek demo jahan agent draft kare,
tum approve/edit/reject karo, aur 20
catches ka reject log dikhao.
Document karo: kaunsa gate fail hua,
kaunsa secret leak check catch hua, kab
tumne publish block kiya.
Maan lo tum freelance ya in-house
solutions role chase kar rahe ho — hiring
manager ko 2x R&D headline se interest
hoga, lekin trust reject log se aayega.
Hypothetical path hai. Guaranteed offer
claim nahi.
Mera take simple hai.
METR ka 1.9x AECI signal aur ~2x
subjective read yeh kehte hain: capability
tempo up hai, transparency partial hai
kyunki redactions heavy hain.
Tumhari career bet: model name yaad rakhne
se zyada, gates design karna.
Harness. Verify. Approve. Log rejects.
Jab AI R&D 2x chale, jo human gates likhta
hai woh replace nahi hota — usko hire kiya
jata hai.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
